name: Mail-in home video, photo and slide digitisation
one_liner: Customers post their old VHS/camcorder tapes, photos and slides to you; you send back digital files and the originals.
customer: Families, often after a bereavement, who have tapes they can't play any more
offer: Tape-to-digital transfer delivered as a download or flash drive, with photo and slide scanning as add-ons
how_it_makes_money: Per tape ($15–$30) or per hour of footage (A RS Video charges $18.75–$25/hr with a $25 minimum). The video's example: 15 tapes a week at $25 is about $1,600 a month
startup_cost: low (~$200 capture device plus a used VCR and a computer you already have; 'a few hundred' all in)
time_to_first_revenue: about 3 months in the case example (first paid job in month 3)
evidence: Independent operators on Reddit's data hoarder forum report charging $20–$30 per tape (yrbH5R-j5DI)
A RS Video says it has transferred more than 250,000 hours of tape (yrbH5R-j5DI)
Harry's first paid job was 11 tapes at $25 each = $275, and referrals came in by month 9 (yrbH5R-j5DI)
risks: Large national competitors (Legacybox, iMemories) keep prices around $15 per tape
Labour is real-time, so 1 hour of tape takes about 1 hour of capture
Liability if irreplaceable originals are lost or damaged in the post
Demand shrinks as the supply of old tapes runs out

name: Mail-in teddy bear and stuffed toy repair
one_liner: Customers post you sentimental stuffed toys; you quote from photos, repair them and post them back.
customer: Adults and parents with sentimental childhood toys
offer: Repairs quoted from photos (seams, stuffing, eyes, fabric patches)
how_it_makes_money: Hourly pricing with a minimum. One Etsy listing charges $20 per half hour with a 2.5 hour minimum, so the smallest job is $100. Three jobs a week is about $1,300 a month
startup_cost: low (sewing machine, needles, thread and stuffing; 'a few hundred at most')
evidence: An Etsy listing charges $20 per half hour with a 2.5 hour minimum (yrbH5R-j5DI)
Bearland Designs and Whiny Bears take repairs by mail with photo quotes and intake forms (yrbH5R-j5DI)
A related case in the same video: a small shop charges more than $1,300 to turn old T-shirts into one quilt (yrbH5R-j5DI)
risks: Needs manual craft skill
Income is capped by your own hours
Emotional liability if a repair goes wrong

name: Mail-in game controller drift repair
one_liner: Gamers post you drifting PlayStation/Xbox/Switch controllers; you replace the joystick modules and post them back.
offer: Stick drift repair, priced per stick plus parts
how_it_makes_money: Flat fee per repair (Ties Controller Repair charges $20 per stick plus the new stick)
startup_cost: low (soldering kit and parts; amount not stated)
evidence: Ties Controller Repair in Hamilton, Ontario takes mail-in jobs from across Canada at $20 per stick repair plus the new stick (yrbH5R-j5DI)
risks: Low ticket price, so it only works at high volume
Soldering skill required
Manufacturer warranties and newer Hall-effect controllers reduce demand

name: Personalised 3D-printed products on Etsy
one_liner: Start with a few home printers and sell custom or niche 3D-printed products on Etsy, then grow into your own store.
customer: Etsy shoppers buying personalised gifts and niche items
offer: Custom and own-design 3D-printed products (started with 3D-scanned head figurines)
how_it_makes_money: Product margin of about 50% on own designs. Revenue went from $50K in year 1 to $400K in year 2 and nearly $1M in total
startup_cost: low to start (a couple of printers), growing to about $100K of machines
time_to_first_revenue: unknown (sold on Etsy soon after starting about 2.5 years ago; year 1 = $50K)
evidence: 'We did almost a million in revenue and $100,000 of machines. Organically grown from our basement' (2gIfoiaWfY0)
'First year we did $50,000. Second year we did 400,000' (2gIfoiaWfY0)
'We aim for about 50% margin on our own stuff' (2gIfoiaWfY0)
Started while working full-time as a remote software engineer (2gIfoiaWfY0)
risks: Etsy competition and copycat designs
Printers need physical supervision and maintenance
IP issues with licensed or fan designs
Fulfilment workload grows with volume

name: AI-built websites for local businesses
one_liner: Use AI builders (Lovable, Base44, Bolt) to produce client-ready websites for local businesses in minutes, and sell builds plus upkeep.
customer: Local service businesses (car washes, salons, cleaners, dentists, contractors)
offer: Professional site with services and pricing, reviews, booking or contact form, and lead-gen landing pages
how_it_makes_money: Per-build fee plus monthly hosting and maintenance (prices not stated in the transcript)
startup_cost: low (AI builder subscriptions, roughly $20–$50/mo; not stated)
evidence: Weak: a tool comparison, not a revenue case. Builds took 3–8 minutes with no errors; the creator calls it 'usually the easiest service for a freelancer to sell and also the one most clients ask for first' (wQHN72Ht2KA)
risks: No revenue evidence; heavily commoditised
Business owners can increasingly build their own sites
The creator promotes a paid course
Selling to local businesses often needs calls

name: Niche AI lead-response automation for estate agents
one_liner: An automation service for estate agents covering instant lead follow-up, enquiry triage and weekly performance reports.
customer: Estate agents and brokers (also dental, legal, e-commerce)
offer: Three AI agents: instant follow-up, enquiry triage, weekly reporting
how_it_makes_money: Upfront setup fee plus a monthly retainer (amounts not stated)
evidence: Weak: tutorial without figures. The video argues that in real estate 'a single closed deal may cover an entire year of agency fees' and that the main pain is slow lead response (i4z0kCcByY8)
risks: No pricing or case data in the transcript
Crowded 'AI agency' market
Sales usually need calls and trust
UK GDPR and portal (Rightmove) integration limits
Ongoing maintenance and support

name: Paid micro-consulting booking link sold to your email list
one_liner: Sell short paid calls ($5 for 5 minutes) to your network by email as a foot in the door for higher-ticket coaching and audits.
customer: Business owners and people interested in business ideas in your network
offer: Prepaid 5-minute consult, upsold to coaching packages and AI audits
how_it_makes_money: Prepaid bookings via Stripe ($1/min, about $60/hr), with upsells for the real profit
startup_cost: low (TidyCal one-off licence plus Omnisend/Stripe; near zero)
time_to_first_revenue: days (the test ran for 1 week; outcome not shown in the excerpt)
evidence: Weak: the creator set up $5 for 5-minute bookings and emailed a randomised segment of their network; the $120K/yr claim is the creator's own arithmetic, not results (guJiTrw9qV4)
risks: Needs an existing network or audience
Live calls cut against async
The $120K figure assumes full booking
Mostly a demo of a gateway to upsells
